**Caption:**

xAI is now part of SpaceX. Let that sink in.

Not a partnership. Not a licensing deal. A full acquisition, with one goal: AI inference running from orbit, powered by solar energy collected in space.

Solar in orbit collects power around the clock, with no weather interference, no night cycle, and no grid dependency. Energy density up there is roughly 8x what you get on the surface. Pair that with AI models running from orbit and you have compute that's geographically unrestricted, energy-abundant, and outside any single nation's infrastructure.

SpaceX already has the rockets, the launch cadence, and Starlink's global network backbone. xAI has the models. The machine that builds the machine is starting to include the machine that thinks.

This is a civilization-level unlock. Not this year. But the direction is locked in.
